description: Synthetic offline golden set for the S1-04 memory-extraction decision gate. Every window is fabricated for this file: no production text, no real user names, paths or repository facts. positives/negatives carry an expected extract/skip label; fallback cases carry a window defect and must take the deterministic fallback regardless of any model answer.
labelDefinition: A durable fact the original extraction could obtain from the complete window and that is useful in future sessions. Durable means it still holds in a later session (a preference, an explicit correction, a project constraint, a durable tool trap, or a fact confirmed across messages); temporary progress, index duplicates, tool noise and unconfirmed assistant guesses are not durable. Two reviewers label each window independently and every disagreement is counted conservatively as positive (extract).
stubPolicy: Class-derived scaffolding for the offline harness only: positives are answered with a high probability so the extract path is exercised, negatives with a probability at or below the skip threshold so the skip path is exercised. This is NOT a model measurement — a report produced with it is invalid for release.
